title: See each coverage area without a product verdict
preconditions: A valid Saga can be evaluated in current-state or comparison mode.

steps.action: Generate the coverage report for the selected scope.
steps.expected_result: The report succeeds and keeps implementation, stories, personas, design, quality, and health separate.

steps.action: Read the human report and its covered and uncovered entries.
steps.expected_result: Each area is understandable without parsing JSON and no blended score or verdict appears.

expected_result: Pass when all six areas have stable readable sections and explicit covered or uncovered entries; fail on a missing area, null list, blended score, or verdict.
